name: nexus_get_updated_mods
description:
Get all mods for a game that changed within a time window [v1 - uses v1 REST quota].

Returns:
    JSON array of {mod_id, latest_file_update (epoch), latest_mod_activity (epoch)}.
    Server-cached 5 minutes. Useful to check if your own mod page saw activity.

domain_name.description: Nexus Mods game domain (lowercase URL slug), e.g. 'forzahorizon6', 'skyrimse'. NOT the display name.
domain_name.title: Domain Name

period.description: Time window: '1d' (last day), '1w' (last week), or '1m' (last month).
period.title: Period
